gap: At the peak (v6.314) the frame is a flat orange-to-white gradient: the wall cards are washed down to faint ghosts and the room hasn't come in yet, so nothing reads for that beat. Keep the wall's darker shapes, or the room's window and beams, showing through the flare at about 30-40% contrast.
notes: Big improvement on a white wipe: the hot spot upper left, the horizontal streak and the ghost ring read as a lens flare in the right sun colour. 6.45 is lovely: the window, beams, floor gobo and SPEX card come through the haze. By 6.65 the room is fully established. The exposure ramp still steps hard from v6.207 (wall plainly visible) to v6.314 (near-flat) and back down by v6.421, so the peak feels like a pulse instead of a swell. The ghost ring sits in the flat lower right and reads a bit like a stamp; it should track the flare axis. Minor: the room text block pops in between v6.636 and v6.743.
